en.seoTitle: What Is Open Knowledge Format (OKF)? | SourceShelf
en.metaDescription: Learn how Open Knowledge Format packages Markdown, metadata, and provenance into portable AI knowledge—and how to use it with SourceShelf and ChatGPT Projects.
en.excerpt: OKF turns a collection of Markdown files into a portable, structured knowledge bundle that both people and AI tools can understand.
en.ctaTitle: Create portable AI knowledge with SourceShelf
en.ctaDescription: Capture webpages, convert documents, build focused packs, and export your knowledge as Markdown, OKF, llms.txt, or AI-ready reference bundles—all locally on your Mac.
en.ctaButton: View SourceShelf on the Mac App Store
en.heroAlt: PDFs, webpages, and Office files flow into a SourceShelf Pack, which branches into an open OKF Bundle ZIP and a practical ChatGPT Context Pack.
